quests.title: The Azure Cloud Invitation
quests.summary: Elder Bai offers a place in the sect to anyone who can prove they belong.
quests.completion: The Azure Cloud has accepted you.

steps.text: Seek Elder Bai at the Azure Cloud hall
Slay 3 spirit beasts beyond the market
Gather 2 spirit herbs from the garden
Attune at the Azure Cloud shrine

quests.title: Tempering the Outer Disciple
quests.summary: Elder Bai sets a proving errand before the sect calls you more than a guest.
quests.completion: Elder Bai nods: the sect's stores are full and the shrine has heard you.

steps.text: Provide for the sect's stores — cull beasts or gather herbs
Carry the offering to the shrine

quests.title: The Market's Ledger
quests.summary: The notice board carries a merchant-league contract: spend at the stalls, thin the marsh boars.
quests.completion: The league's clerk strikes the contract from the board.

steps.text: Buy three lots from the market stalls
Clear two beasts from the marsh road

quests.title: First Descent
quests.summary: Instructor Rui wants a disciple who has walked a hidden realm and stood at an altar.
quests.completion: Rui hears the account and marks you ready for the inner yard.

steps.text: Begin an inheritance trial at an altar
Report your descent to Instructor Rui
